[[File:Hurrikaine2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Unidentified Hurikane species|Hurikane native]] hands [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] some Hurrikaine crystals]]

'''Hurrikaine crystals''', also spelt '''Hurikane crystals''',<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> were deep blue to violet [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hurikane]] admired for their unparalleled beauty. When used in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], they created blades that were very good at penetrating defenses.

[[File:MaceWindu_CN.png|thumb|left|150px|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] wielded a [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] made with Hurrikaine crystals.]]
In [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]], a young [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] was sent to Hurikane on a [[Mission to Hurikane|mission]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. During the mission he harmed a local with force repulse. Upon realizing this, Mace used force heal to help the local. In exchange for helping the [[Unidentified Hurikane species|stone-encrusted native species]], Windu was given a handful of the rare amethyst Hurrikaine crystals, which he used to create his unique [[Electrum/Legends|electrum]] lightsaber. The [[Windu's Guile]] crystal was later named in honor of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]].

==Behind the scenes==
"Hurrikaine" crystals appear in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|Knights of the Old Republic II]]'', and possess many of the attributes associated with Mace Windu's lightsaber, including its amethyst color.
